payload.body: **ST0001 WP07 done (e3641d9, local).** contact (scan, due, show, log, next, context, render) runs natively; no bin/ or lib/ file touched. **Fixed before commit:** the bug the scratch run caught (log --email handed the fallback 'log ...' without 'contact', so bats was 99/101). **Re-measured from a scratch worktree after the fix** (slot 01M6EJPY803BANMKJVF6BBRKT8, result written after the run): fmt 0, clippy 0, cargo test 70 unit and 22 integration passed, 0 failed; golden replay 35 of 54 native, all match, every contact and tag case among them; bats Rust 101/101, legacy 101/101. AT-07.1 (to-write, red, green) covers AC-07.1; wp gate PASS; claim released; people-leak clean at commit. **Simplifications:** with tag's (Contact).md re-render native, nothing native delegates any more, so cli::DELEGATES, fully_native and fallback::run_quietly are gone; the shared walk and display name moved into tree.rs (person_dirs, display_name), used by tags and contact. log --email stays on the legacy script until WP14 (AC-14.1). The shared renders also carry dc's WP08 start. Next: WP10 (sync: check, link, pull, photos, backup) on dc's store contract.
